main_body: Wooden display counter (rows 22-31) with a glass cake dome standing on it (rows 10-22). The dome is drawn face-on.
top_band: At the middle column the dome's glass and cake interior run from row 10 to 21. A cream plate strip at rows 21-22 and an orange strip at rows 22-23 follow, then a dark line at row 23. There is no real horizontal top surface, only 1-2 px bands.
evidence: The wooden base has only a 1-2 row orange lip with a dark line under it, then a flat front face with inset panels at rows 24-30. That is a rim, not a top surface. The glass dome and the cake layers are seen straight from the front, as a vertical silhouette with no visible horizontal surface from above. The cream plate at row 21 is too thin to count. This is a front elevation, not 3/4.

style.evidence: The glass is a large flat pale-blue fill with only a thin edge highlight and no grain or reflections. The wood base has about 3-4 tones with flat panel fills and no grain. The cake has a few tones but little texture. The dark brown outline on the base is tinted, but the glass has almost no outline. Compared with the stall and well references, which have tile scallops, stone shading and wood grain, the tiles carry fewer colours and read thinner and flatter.
